answer_1.quote: we propose a new research task: reasoning-based object detection. In essence, humans provide abstract queries via natural language, then the model discerns and reasons which objects in the image may fulfill the query, subsequently detecting them.
answer_1.outputs: object names and bounding boxes based on natural language instructions and image input

answer_2.quote: We conduct evaluation using the conventional metric for object detection, i.e., mean average precision (mAP), which quantifies how well the predicted bounding boxes overlap with the ground truth ones.
